hypothesis: Repointing risky-1 and risky-3 (fleet_rest, paper, real_fills) from V15_BOLD_TIERS (OTM-2/OTM-3 under $2K) to V15_BOLD_CORE_TIERS (ATM under $2K -- the SAME table core Bold was wired to 2026-07-17/18) increases the fraction of named-setup ticks that clear the $0.30 min_entry_premium floor, without a corresponding P&L or risk regression on those two arms.
mechanism: V15_BOLD_TIERS prices the $0-2K bracket at strike_offset=-3 (OTM-3), which the 2026-07-15 study (bold-strike-axis-2026-07-15.json) measured clearing the floor on only 33.76% of afternoon signals vs ATM's 96.88%. The 2026-07-31 gate-provenance audit (min-entry-premium-2026-07-31.json) confirmed risky-1 alone lost 15/16 named-setup ticks to this exact floor collision on a single day. V15_BOLD_CORE_TIERS is not new/unvalidated machinery -- it is the identical table already live on core Bold (heartbeat_core.py, j_intent_executor.py) since 2026-07-17/18, extended here to two more consumers of the SAME shared function (_tiers_for_arm).
